top_choice_rationale: P004 (Wolynes, Onuchic, Fersht) honours a quantitative, falsifiable physical picture of protein folding, the funnelled energy landscape, together with the protein-engineering and phi-value experiments that made folding transition states visible; it is mature, mechanistic and complements the 2024 structure-prediction prize by explaining why a sequence reaches its fold. The Bryngelson and Dill priority question and the theory-plus-experiment pairing remain for the expert reports. P002 (targeted protein degradation) is next as a genuine new mechanistic principle, with timing and the third-place choice still open; P001 is the cleanest on attribution but a sequel to the 2010 prize; P003 depends on unresolved in-cell evidence.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; none of the credited names appears in my profile. Stockholm University colleague of Xiaodong Zou and long-time colleague of Johan Aqvist, which does not bear on any proposal.
